description: For mutually inverse maps \(f:A\to B\) and \(g:B\to A\), \(f(S)=g^{-1}(S)\) for every \(S\subseteq A\). Equivalently, \(f^{-1}(T)=g(T)\) for every \(T\subseteq B\).
signature:
Set.image_eq_preimage_of_inverse.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
  (h₁ : Function.LeftInverse g f) (h₂ : Function.RightInverse g f) : Set.image f = Set.preimage g
